note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a MHL 403; A06b MHL 403; L05 MHL 406): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Marshall Islands, 2024
sources.said: Ordinarily resident in RMI for 10 years ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Minister can apply to High Court for cancellation of citizenship where person has obtained the nationality or citizenship of another country by a voluntary act (other than marriage or with the express approval of the Cabinet).
